args.title: Bellwether Office — Retail Returns Logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of the Bellwether Office newsletter on retail returns logistics, the linked article, and the subscriber companion piece.

- Newsletter (newsletter@bellwether.example, "Retail returns logistics"): this week's theme is retail returns logistics; it links to the full article at https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and flags that the companion piece is subscriber-only.

- Article (https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns): apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating returns into dedicated return hubs cuts handling cost by about a fifth (~20%). It points to a companion piece at https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion.

- Companion piece (subscriber access via team code SUB-1746): speed to resale is the key margin lever — getting returned items back into resale within 10 days preserved most of the margin.

Sources: newsletter email; blog article; subscriber companion (accessed with Northwind team subscription code).
